data.name: ActivationFailed
data.value: MSTest could not create test class '{0}' from the application host service provider. Ensure that exactly one public constructor can be satisfied by registered services and TestContext.

data.name: AmbiguousConstructors
data.value: MSTest could not select a unique public constructor for test class '{0}'. Mark one constructor with ActivatorUtilitiesConstructorAttribute or remove the ambiguity.

data.name: DerivedTestContextParameter
data.value: MSTest cannot supply constructor parameter '{1}' on test class '{0}' because it derives from TestContext. Use TestContext exactly.
data.comment: {0} is the test class name. {1} is the constructor parameter type. {Locked="MSTest"}{Locked="TestContext"}

data.name: MultiplePreferredConstructors
data.value: MSTest could not select a constructor for test class '{0}' because multiple public constructors are marked with ActivatorUtilitiesConstructorAttribute. Mark exactly one constructor.

data.name: DynamicCodeNotSupported
data.value: MSTest test-class injection from Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting requires runtime dynamic code and is not supported by this runtime.
